title: Toofan
desc: Separated at birth, the paths of Shyam, a lousy magician unwittingly roped into a crime, and Toofan, a defender of the people, cross again years later as they reunite to avenge their father.

title: Jai Ho
desc: A former Indian military officer devises a unique plan to promote social responsibility amongst apathetic civilians. The masses embrace his initiative, but he must confront a potent political family.

title: Biwi No. 1
desc: Two adorable kids, a quirky mother-in-law and a happy-go-lucky friend help a heartbroken wife bring a straying husband back from the other woman's tangled embrace.

title: Jigar
desc: Duryodhan, a wrestler, is Raju's friend, but due to a misunderstanding he rapes and kills Raju's sister. Raju later seeks Baba Thakur's help to train in fighting to avenge his sister's death.

title: Mard
desc: Azad, a wealthy prosperous king, is locked in a dungeon by General Dyer who wants to take over his kingdom. Years later, Azad's son comes to his father's rescue and puts an end to Dyer's tyranny.
